title: Eleanor Roosevelt letter to Oppenheimer

tellings.quote: the rumors of UFOs at Los Alamos and other nuclear sites were so widespread that Elanor Roosevelt wrote to Oppenheimer inquiring about them responding with a letter that's been fully verified and archived in the Library of Congress Oppenheimer wrote back reassuring the former first lady that these were just rumors

plain: Michels says rumors of UFOs over Los Alamos, the New Mexico laboratory where the atomic bomb was built, and over other nuclear sites spread so far that the former first lady Eleanor Roosevelt wrote to the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer to ask about them. According to Michels, Oppenheimer wrote back to reassure her that they were only rumors, and his letter has been verified and is kept in the Library of Congress. Michels tells this himself, as a sign of how widely such sightings were talked about at the top in the late 1940s.
